request: Test DebugAI existing design: isolated owned nested worktree exact source commit, syntax and evidence-review regression without model inference

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
branch=fix/debugai-hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028
target=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028
expected=e4040b3da34f53a5da5bd51dd47a10cb66b2b93c
root=$(realpath "$p")
[ "$root" = /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai ] || { echo SOURCE_PARENT_MISMATCH; exit 3; }
[ -d "$root/.git" ] || [ -f "$root/.git" ] || { echo NOT_GIT_PARENT; exit 3; }
case "$target" in "$root"/.worktrees/*) ;; *) echo WORKTREE_SCOPE_DENIED; exit 3;; esac
if [ -e "$target" ]; then
  existing=$(git -C "$target" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ "$existing" = "$expected" ] || { echo EXISTING_WORKTREE_MISMATCH; exit 4; }
else
  git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$branch"
  actual=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
  [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { echo REMOTE_BRANCH_MOVED; exit 4; }
  git -C "$p" worktree add --detach "$target" "$actual"
fi
echo "DEBUGAI_TEST_HEAD=$(git -C "$target" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "DEBUGAI_WORKTREE_REALPATH=$(realpath "$target")"
echo "CREATED_NEW_TOP_LEVEL_SIBLING=NO"
cd "$target"
node --check server/workflow.js
node --check server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs
echo SYNTAX=PASS
set +e
NODE_PATH="$p/node_modules" node --test server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/external-review-verdict-contract.test.cjs
code=$?
set -e
echo "FOCUSED_TEST_EXIT=$code"
exit "$code"
